full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that informant P.W.1, S.I. Md. Abul Khayer Shikder of Khan Khanapur Police Investigating Centre of Rajbari arrested accused Md. Shaheen Shaikh alias Pichchi Shaheen in connection with Faridpur Kotwali Police Station Case No. 4 dated 03.02.2004 corresponding to G.R. No. 56 of 2002 under Sections 143/323/324/379 of the Penal Code. During interrogation accused Shaheen alias Pichchi Shaheen confessed that he is a member of Sharbohara Party headed by the convict appellant, Nayeb Ali of unauthorized village and they have got some unauthorized arms in their possession by which they have committed several crimes within Rajbari District. Accused Shaheen alias Pichchi Shaheen further disclosed that the unauthorized arms are lying at. Ujanchar of Bahadurpur village beside the house of one Md. Ismail, son of late Baku Shaikh. As per his confession the police party on 03.07.2003 at 08:30 P.M. took him to the house of said Md. Ismail Shaikh and recovered one L.G. measuring 18 inches with two cartridges from the stack of jute sticks piled up in the western side of the house of the local witnesses.
